description: ProjectAlign - Digital Projector Assistant for artists. Allows importing images, precise alignment, and locking for projection.

userStories.title: Image Import & Sandbox Storage
userStories.description: As an artist, I want to select an image and have it saved to the app's internal storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Initialize project scaffolding: DONE
Integration of expo-image-picker for gallery access
Integration of expo-file-system for local storage
Feature: Select image and copy to DocumentDirectory with unique ID
UI: Simple button to trigger import
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented with expo-file-system v19 new API. Verified in browser.

userStories.title: Alignment Workspace (Gestures)
userStories.description: As an artist, I want to manipulate the image to align it with my canvas using gestures.
acceptanceCriteria: Install react-native-gesture-handler and react-native-reanimated
Component: AlignmentWorkspace
Feature: Simultaneous Pan, Pinch (Scale), and Rotation gestures
Feature: Reset button to restore default transform
Performance: Smooth 60fps interactions
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented AlignmentWorkspace with Reanimated gestures (Simultaneous Pan, Pinch, Rotate). Verified verification via web build (gestures require touch/mouse simulation).

userStories.title: Modes & UI Layout
userStories.description: As an artist, I want to switch between Edit and Projection modes to prevent accidental changes.
acceptanceCriteria: UI: Toggle switch for Edit/Projection Mode
Feature: Edit Mode shows full UI and active gestures
Feature: Projection Mode disables gestures and dims/hides UI
Visual Interaction: Clearly indicate current mode (e.g., border or icon)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented Edit/Projection modes. Projection mode disables gestures and hides header/buttons. Verified in browser.

userStories.title: Persistence
userStories.description: As an artist, I want my alignment and image selection to be saved automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
Feature: Auto-save transform values (x, y, scale, rotation)
Feature: specific Project ID referencing the image file
Feature: Restore last active project state on app launch
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented StorageService with AsyncStorage. Auto-saves transform on gesture end (debounced). Restores project state on app launch. Verified in browser.

userStories.title: Device Wake Lock
userStories.description: As an artist, I need the screen to stay awake while I am projecting.
acceptanceCriteria: Install expo-keep-awake
Feature: Prevent screen sleep when in Projection Mode
Feature: Allow screen sleep when in Edit Mode (or default behavior)
Ensure dark background/theme is enforced
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented expo-keep-awake with activateKeepAwakeAsync/deactivateKeepAwake. Screen stays awake in Projection Mode, allows sleep in Edit Mode. Dark background enforced. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Global Gesture Area
userStories.description: As an artist, I want to pinch/rotate anywhere on the screen, not just on the image bounds, for easier manipulation.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature: Pinch gesture works anywhere in the workspace, not just on image
Feature: Rotation gesture works anywhere in the workspace
Feature: Pan gesture can optionally require starting on image or work globally
Gestures should feel natural and responsive regardless of finger position
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Moved GestureDetector to wrap entire workspace. Pinch, rotation, and pan gestures now work anywhere on screen. Verified in browser.

userStories.title: Consistent Image Position Between Modes
userStories.description: As an artist, I need the image position to remain exactly the same when switching between Edit and Projection modes so my alignment is accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Bug: Image shifts when switching modes due to header show/hide
Fix: Image position must be pixel-perfect between Edit and Projection modes
Feature: Workspace layout should not depend on header visibility
Consider: Use absolute positioning or fullscreen workspace in both modes
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Refactored layout to use absolute positioning for workspace. Fixed border-width shift issue by keeping border constant and toggling color. Verified pixel-perfect consistency in browser.

userStories.title: Multi-Project Management
userStories.description: As an artist, I want to save multiple projects (each with their own image and alignment) and easily switch between them.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature: Save current project with name/identifier
Feature: List all saved projects
Feature: Load a specific project from the list
Feature: Delete a project from the list
Feature: Each project stores: image URI, transform values, name, last modified
UI: Project selector/picker interface
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented multi-project management with List view, Create flow, and Delete capability. StorageService refactored to support collections.

userStories.title: Safe Launch Mode (Default to Projection)
userStories.description: As an artist, when I open a project, I want it to start in Projection Mode (safe/locked) so I don't accidentally move my aligned image.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature: When selecting a project, immediately launch into Projection Mode (locked gestures)
UI: Explicit 'Unlock for Editing' or 'Enter Edit Mode' flow
Safety: Prevent accidental gestures on load
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented safe launch (defaults to Projection Mode) when opening projects. Updated label to 'Unlock for Editing' for clarity. Verified in browser.

userStories.title: Migrate to Safe Area Context
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to use `react-native-safe-area-context` instead of `SafeAreaView` to ensure consistent and correct padding on all devices (especially phones with modern notches/dynamic islands).
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor: Replace React Native `SafeAreaView` with `SafeAreaProvider` and `SafeAreaView` (or `useSafeAreaInsets`) from `react-native-safe-area-context`
Visual: Verify content does not clip under status bar or home indicator
Visual: Ensure immersive mode (Projection) handles insets correctly (e.g. status bar hidden but safe areas respected if needed)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Migrated from legacy SafeAreaView to react-native-safe-area-context. Verified UI stability and type safety.

userStories.title: Safe Project Navigation
userStories.description: As an artist, I want to switch projects safely without entering Edit Mode, preventing accidental exits during projection.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature: Separate 'Exit Project' navigation from 'Edit Mode' controls
Interaction: Implement a safety trigger (e.g., long press or specific corner area) to show navigation controls in Projection Mode
Efficiency: Allow returning to Project List without unlocking the image for editing
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Ensuring project switching doesn't require unlocking the canvas.
